entry.title: Detroit Tigers offseason notes: Arbitration-eligible Tigers who got tenders: RHP Beau Brieske OF Kerry Carpenter OF Riley Greene LHP Tyler Holton OF Parker Meadows IF/OF Zach McKinstry RHP Reese Olson OF Wenceel Pérez 1B Spencer Torkelson RHP Will Vest
Matt Vierling: Tigers tendered contracts to all 10 arb-eligible players on their 40-man roster. No non-tenders beyond Matt Vierling, who was designated for assignment on Tuesday.

Troy Melton: Troy Melton was not yet arb eligible, having just over a year of service time. His 6-year, $46.5m extension pending physical is the longest contract for a Tigers pitcher since Verlander's 7-year extension in 2013. It would cover Melton's arb years plus a year of free agency, 2 with a club option.
Jace Jung: The Tigers have traded INF Jace Jung to the Los Angeles Angels for a cash consideration.

Emilio Pagán: "We have to be open-minded. We have to look to add innings in a number of different ways. Everything is on the table for us right now.” --Scott Harris after officially announcing the signing of reliever Emilio Pagan
Sawyer Gipson-Long: Pitchers Sawyer Gipson-Long and Bailey Horn have signed back with the Tigers on minor league deals.

Maddox Long: Good story from colleague Jesse Borek on Maddox Long, a big (6-5, 275) RHP who made a big impression in AFL after signing with Tigers out of Indy ball back in June. www.mlb.com/news/tigers-...

Detroit Tigers staff and front office: Tigers finalize their coaching staff, formally announcing Kyle Hudson and Martin Maldonado as coaches. Catching coach Ryan Sienko will also serve as bullpen coach, filling an opening left when assistant pitching coach Juan Nieves was not retained.
Kenley Jansen: Tigers decline $12 million option on Kenley Jansen, he will hit free agency two saves shy of 500....other moves...
Tsung-Che Cheng: Confirming Masslive report, Tigers have acquired left-handed hitting middle infielder Tsung-Che Cheng from Boston for cash
